name: TRL
summary: Hugging Face Transformer Reinforcement Learning library for post-training methods such as SFT, DPO, PPO and GRPO on top of transformers.
description: Established Apache-2.0 library (huggingface/trl; not archived; not a 2026 launch). PyPI trl 1.17.1 verified 2026-11-11; docs https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/index verified 2026-11-12 (https://huggingface.co/docs/trl redirects there). Install with pip install trl. Used with Hugging Face transformers and often PEFT adapters. Model weights, GPUs and any hosted training services are separate from the open-source library.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install trl. Model and GPU resources are configured separately.
